parameters.query:
INSERT INTO anteraja_chat_state (phone, tracking_number, client_token, last_template, last_message_at, context, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now(), $5::jsonb, now())
ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
  tracking_number = EXCLUDED.tracking_number,
  client_token = EXCLUDED.client_token,
  last_template = EXCLUDED.last_template,
  last_message_at = now(),
  context = EXCLUDED.context,
  updated_at = now()

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Susun Pesan').item.json.phone }},{{ $('Susun Pesan').item.json.tracking_number }},{{ $('Susun Pesan').item.json.client_token }},{{ $('Susun Pesan').item.json.template }},{{ JSON.stringify($('Susun Pesan').item.json.context) }}
